label: Unit of analysis mismatch
description: Observations treated as independent when they are nested (pseudoreplication; repeated measures without random effects)

label: Confounded manipulation
description: The exposure or stimulus co-varies with another cause of the outcome

label: Unmodelled order or carryover
description: Crossover or repeated design without carryover or washout assessment

label: Inadequate control condition
description: Control does not isolate the factor of interest

label: Power analysis mismatch
description: Sample size justification does not correspond to the primary contrast or uses unjustified inputs

label: Blinding absent or unreported
description: Raters or extractors not blinded where feasible

label: No manipulation check
description: No evidence that the intended state or exposure occurred

label: No pre-registration
description: Primary hypothesis and analysis not registered; hypothesis possibly post hoc

label: Construct validity gap
description: The measured proxy does not support the construct claimed

label: Reliability not established
description: No or inadequate reliability evidence for the instrument in this setting

label: Scale type violated
description: Ordinal treated as interval or counts treated as continuous without justification

label: Derived score defect
description: Change scores or composites ill-defined; sign lost; shared-baseline artefact

label: Missing data mishandled
description: Amount or mechanism of missingness not reported or handled inappropriately

label: Measured covariates ignored
description: Relevant measured covariates not used in the analysis

label: Wrong distributional family
description: Likelihood does not match the outcome type

label: Model structure mismatch
description: Model omits structure the design requires (random effects clustering order)

label: Assumption check on wrong object
description: Normality or other checks on raw data rather than residuals or predictive checks

label: Untested interaction
description: Parallel slopes or homogeneous effects assumed without test

label: Multiplicity unaddressed
description: Many tests or outcomes with no adjustment or framing

label: Selective model reporting
description: Only the favourable model or specification is reported

label: Bayesian specification gap
description: Priors convergence or sensitivity not reported

label: Statistic inconsistent with descriptives
description: Reported test statistic or p-value cannot be reproduced from reported summaries

label: Impossible mean or SD
description: Reported mean or SD arithmetically impossible for n and scale (GRIM/GRIMMER)

label: Sign or direction inconsistency
description: Reported differences or deltas disagree in sign or magnitude with reported means

label: Text figure table disagreement
description: Numbers or significance markers differ across sections

label: Duplicated or contradictory text
description: Repeated or mutually contradictory passages

label: Reporting guideline not met
description: Claimed guideline items missing

label: No effect size with uncertainty
description: Results reported as p-values without estimates and intervals

label: Code or data not available
description: Data on request only; no code

label: Conclusion not supported by results
description: Main conclusion does not follow from the reported data

label: Discussion contradicts results
description: Discussion states the opposite of a reported result

label: Overgeneralisation
description: Claims beyond the sample population species or setting

label: Causal language in non-causal design
description: Causal claims from observational or confounded data

label: Unsupported mechanism
description: Mechanistic explanation presented without evidence or labelled inconsistently

label: Comparison without comparator
description: Claims relative to other groups or species not present in the data
